newsitem.title: FINLAND: Ruutunelonen to get new Finnish TV station - agency.
newsitem.headline: Ruutunelonen to get new Finnish TV station - agency.

text.p: The Ruutunelonen consortium, mainly owned by Sanoma Oy and the Erkko family's Helsinki Media, is set to win the licence for a fourth national TV channel, the Finnish STT news agency said on Wednesday.
Suomen Uutisradio, owned by MTV, Aamulehti and some media groups linked to political parties, is set to win the licence for a national commercial radio station, it said.
The agency gave no source for its report, but said Social Democrat ministers had decided late on Wednesday how they would vote when the government takes a formal decision on Thursday.
A rival bid has been mounted by A4 media, a group of former journalists, in which Luxembourg-based Compagnie Luxembourgeoise de Telediffusion (CLT) holds a minority stake.
